title: Materialized Views and Concurrent Refresh in PostgreSQL
realWorldScenario: An executive dashboard takes 25 seconds to generate monthly financial summary charts across 40 million transactions.
questionStatement: What is a Materialized View in PostgreSQL? How does `REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW CONCURRENTLY` work, and what unique index is required?
expectedConcepts: REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW CONCURRENTLY non-blocking operation
Mandatory unique index requirement for concurrent refresh
hints: Why does CONCURRENTLY need a unique index to know which rows changed?
